resources.string: Set the always-on clock size independently of the lock screen. Large sizes fit within the native clock area and retain burn-in protection.
Adjust the shade and Quick Settings blur. Lower values use a lighter backdrop; 0 turns blur off. Battery Saver and thermal limits still apply.
Limit common custom ROM software properties, file checks and Hecker component visibility in this app. Close the app to apply. This does not change hardware attestation or guarantee app compatibility.
